title: Grant readiness evidence review
source_text:
# Synthetic grant call extract

This synthetic source set demonstrates source-bound grant readiness review. Applicant statements are separate unverified evidence records.

Clause 1: The maximum grant request is ZAR 2,500,000.
Clause 2: Applicants must supply audited financial statements for the latest two financial years.
Clause 3: Applicants must supply a current safeguarding policy and a board resolution signed by the authorised chair.

obligations.statement: Clause 1: The maximum grant request is ZAR 2,500,000.
Clause 2: Applicants must supply audited financial statements for the latest two financial years.
Clause 3: Applicants must supply a current safeguarding policy and a board resolution signed by the authorised chair.

evidence.text: The applicant reports that only 2024 audited financial statements are supplied.
The applicant states the board resolution is signed by the authorised chair.
The applicant reports the policy is dated 2022 and no current review record was included with the supplied packet.
